title: CADMPEG F3D carrier route and evidence-independence boundary
mode: Exact-release source audit and broader open-source candidate screening
scope: Determine whether CADMPEG's exact v0.6.2 F3D codec adds a distinct open-source semantic witness for the existing DWG/DXF ACIS route.
Separate container/profile coverage from parser implementation lineage and from direct DWG AcDs association evidence.
Reconcile CADMPEG's scored single-document F3D profile with its tagged evaluation ledger.
Screen a recently visible F3D viewer route for source availability, license status, and semantic output level.
Refine the optional PAR-07/S8 composed checkpoint without adding local tests, samples, dependencies, or implementation gates.

sources.revision: Exact tag v0.6.2 resolves to commit 7bcc95276548de4e4876894b9a650a84ea9c4d6d; source and ref fetched 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The CLI package's exact Cargo manifest enables both f3d and sat features by default. The F3D codec package directly depends on cadmpeg-asm, as does the existing bare ASM/SAT implementation family.
sources.limits: Manifest dependencies establish shared implementation lineage, not runtime behavior or independent evidence. No release binary was downloaded or run.

sources.project: CADMPEG tagged F3D codec and support profile
sources.observed: The codec source says F3D body maps select B-rep blobs, .smb/.smbh extensions do not determine history/model role, and selected ASM records flow through cadmpeg-asm. It describes B-rep topology, analytic/cached NURBS geometry, transforms, design/history data, and appearances. The tagged profile assigns L4 to f3d:manifest-3-2-0-0.
sources.limits: This is source and project-authored capability evidence only. It does not make F3D a DWG/DXF parser, prove independent correctness of the shared ASM decoder, or qualify arbitrary Fusion/ASM versions.

sources.observed: The ledger contains an L4 evaluation row for f3d:f3z-multi-document dated 2026-08-28 with 12 files. It reports validation findings on legacy-generation inner documents and one archive exceeding the evaluation time budget. No direct evaluation row for f3d:manifest-3-2-0-0 appears in the ledger.
sources.limits: Absence from this ledger is not proof that no other unpublished evaluation occurred. The F3Z row does not establish direct coverage of every single-document F3D profile or serve as an independent semantic oracle.

sources.project: ezf3d independent Fusion ASM BinaryFile8 reader
sources.revision: Current default-branch HEAD pinned to commit 97fe90ab8c39c3978fa6354f4a21c5ebdbc38c6e, dated 2026-08-28; source, LICENSE, and package metadata reviewed 2026-10-20. GitHub reports no published releases.
sources.observed: The repository is a distinct Python implementation with MIT license. It reads Fusion F3D/F3Z documents and documents embedded ASM BinaryFile8 .smb/.smbh geometry. The project README reports alpha status, four real designs, 42 B-rep bodies, 99.8 MB of Shape Manager data, topology/analytic checks, and comparisons to Fusion's cached display mesh. Its package requires Python >=3.13,<3.14 and does not list CADMPEG as a dependency.
sources.limits: This is a separate parser candidate only for the documented Fusion-contained BinaryFile8 profile until the exact source is executed. Its self-tests and cached mesh share Fusion producer provenance and are not independently authored semantic truth. It does not document DWG/DXF parsing, AcDs association, or generic raw ACIS 217/218 input. No environment, sample, or peer runtime was used.

sources.revision: Mutable main-branch documentation reviewed 2026-10-20; no immutable source commit or package artifact was pinned.
sources.observed: FORMAT_SUPPORT.md describes the F3D path as MIT-licensed and says selected native ShapeManager faces are tessellated with diagnostics for unsupported geometry. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md identifies @jfk-solutions/fusion-file-format as unpublished, proprietary/confidential, all-rights-reserved, and license pending.
sources.limits: The license statements conflict, implementation source is not available for audit in the reviewed evidence, and tessellated display output is not an independent analytic/topological B-rep result. Exclude from open-source candidate admission unless resolved by a published source and license.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: classify exact CADMPEG F3D as a second container/profile coverage lead within the same cadmpeg-asm implementation lineage; do not count it as an independent parser or kernel vote.

PAR-07/S8: pin the existing ezf3d watchlist at commit 97fe90ab8c39c3978fa6354f4a21c5ebdbc38c6e as a distinct MIT parser candidate for exact Fusion-contained ASM BinaryFile8 members only; require a same-byte run before any candidate result and do not assume generic DWG/SAB compatibility.
PAR-07/S8: keep ezf3d optional and non-blocking because it is alpha, has no published release, requires Python 3.13, and its internal cached-mesh checks are not independent expected geometry.

PAR-07/S8: at the existing composed checkpoint only, capture F3D parent/member hashes, dialect, body-map selector resolution, ASM framing/revision, units/transforms, losses, and per-body topology when an exact licensed sample is already available.
PAR-07/S8: do not apply the bare ACIS BinaryFile 217/218 qualification to embedded Fusion ASM payloads; identify the exact branch and revision from payload framing.

Candidate admission: mark the tagged L4 F3D profile as project-authored capability, note the F3Z-only evaluation-ledger entry and its findings/timeout, and exclude the viewer route until its open-license contradiction and source availability are resolved.
End-to-end evidence: retain the DWG section, AcDs DataStorage, entity/key association, exact modeler bytes, DXF carrier, and consumer/native gates as distinct from any F3D result.

planChanges: Added a precise crosswalk between the exact CADMPEG F3D codec and its bare SAT/ASM decoder lineage.
Updated the existing ezf3d watchlist with a pinned MIT source revision and implementation-readiness status as a separate parser candidate for the narrow Fusion-contained ASM BinaryFile8 profile.

Recorded that tagged F3D documentation reports L4 for f3d:manifest-3-2-0-0 while the exact tagged evaluation ledger only records f3d:f3z-multi-document, with legacy validation findings and one timeout.
Added an optional, one-time composed-checkpoint capture recipe for an already-available licensed F3D file; it does not add a dependency, test target, persistent fixture, or blocking gate.
Explicitly prevented transfer of ACIS 217/218 bare BinaryFile qualification to F3D embedded ASM payloads.

Excluded the Native CAD Viewer F3D route from open-source comparator counts pending resolution of its conflicting license claims; noted that its declared geometry result is tessellated display geometry.
Preserved the full DWG/AcDs/DXF/native evidence chain, implementation order, fast-test cadence, fixture policy, support claims, plan counts, and all six DEFERRED_EXTERNAL items.
limitations: Only primary project source/configuration and documentation were reviewed; no F3D sample, CADMPEG executable, browser runtime, native CAD application, or geometry kernel was executed.
The CADMPEG F3D and bare SAT paths share cadmpeg-asm and therefore are correlated parser evidence, not independent votes.
ezf3d is a separate open-source parser implementation, but no run was performed and its exact Fusion-contained BinaryFile8 profile has not been shown compatible with a libdxfrw DWG/DXF carrier.
The F3D L4 profile is project-authored; the tagged evaluations ledger does not contain a direct single-document F3D row.
Native CAD Viewer documentation is mutable and internally inconsistent on the F3D reader's license; no immutable revision or implementation artifact was audited.
No evidence here qualifies DWG container parsing, AcDs association, DXF modeler-carrier writing, LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3 consumption, or native application behavior.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
